title: Tales From Makoko
summary: A photo essay about Samuel, a boy in Makoko who walked to school barefoot, and what changed when that one barrier was removed.
credit: Photographs and text by SageView Production Ltd.

captions.01-tales-from-makoko.jpg: Title frame: Samuel asleep on a patterned mat in a timber room in Makoko, over the title Tales From Makoko.
captions.02-barefoot.jpg: Chapter 1, Barefoot: a boy's bare feet standing on a path strewn with litter, in school shorts.
captions.03-the-walk.jpg: Chapter 2, The Walk: Samuel walking barefoot to school through a smoky fish-smoking yard, exercise books held to his chest.
captions.04-burden.jpg: Chapter 3, Burden: Samuel leaning against a tarpaulin wall, looking down at the book held against his chest.
captions.05-mother-burdens.jpg: Chapter 4, Mother Burdens: Samuel's mother seated by a cooking fire, speaking with her hands open.
captions.06-mother-burdens-school-fees.jpg: Chapter 5, Mother Burdens: Samuel's mother with her hands folded, looking past the camera.
captions.07-intervention.jpg: Chapter 6, Intervention: volunteers in Project R.E.N.E.W shirts handing out bagged school shoes to a crowd of children.
captions.08-intervention-project-renew.jpg: Chapter 7, Intervention: two Project R.E.N.E.W volunteers laughing as a boy in a yellow shirt receives a bagged pair of shoes.
captions.09-new-steps.jpg: Chapter 8, New Steps: Samuel walking to school in black shoes and white socks, carrying his books.
captions.10-classroom.jpg: Chapter 9, Classroom: Samuel writing in an exercise book at a wooden desk among classmates.
captions.11-classroom-confidence.jpg: Chapter 10, Classroom: Samuel at his desk, looking up from his book towards the camera.
captions.12-confidence.jpg: Chapter 11, Confidence: Samuel at the whiteboard working through arithmetic, his back to the class.
captions.13-dignity.jpg: Chapter 12, Dignity: Samuel standing in his school uniform and new shoes, smiling, a younger child watching from the right.
captions.14-hope.jpg: Chapter 13, Hope: two children laughing together beside a washing basin.
captions.15-samuel.jpg: Chapter 14, Samuel: Samuel sitting on the mat in the same room the essay opened in, one arm raised across his face.
